title: After washing, and laying out to dry, it does not feel like Silk!
text:
After washing, and laying out to dry, it does not feel like Silk!. This seems made well, and it has a hidden zipper .

I washed this before sleeping on this silk pillow case.
I layed it on the dryer to dry, and it looked ok after, but was not shiny.

Sleeping on this would tell me the truth about this pillow case that is for a twin bed!
I did not find it as soft as my regular linens that are very good.
Actually this silk looked soft and shiny before I washed it, now its like a regular not expensive pillow case.
